title: Logic Puzzles — Easy Level
description: A collection of easy logic puzzles and riddles.

questions.explanation: The next number is obtained by adding the two previous numbers: 5 + 8 = 13.

questions.text: How many apples grow on a birch tree?
questions.explanation: Apples grow on apple trees, not on birch trees.

questions.text: Two hippos are flying: one is white, the other is flying to the right. How much does one kilogram of asphalt weigh if the hedgehog is five years old?
questions.explanation: The color and direction of the hippos, as well as the hedgehog's age, are irrelevant. One kilogram of asphalt weighs one kilogram.

questions.text: He comes uninvited in the evening and disappears in the morning, even when asked to stay. What is it?
questions.explanation: Sleep comes in the evening when a person falls asleep and ends when they wake up.

questions.text: What letter appears twice in 'summer', once in 'minute', and not at all in 'year'?
questions.explanation: The word 'summer' contains two M's, 'minute' contains one, and 'year' contains none.
